comparisons.classification: synthetic coupled prediction; no execution or billing

network.classification: synthetic predicted store-and-forward; no execution or compliance certification
network.policy: greedy earliest-arrival simple paths; jobs ordered by release and ID

dynamics.classification: synthetic predicted feasibility; no observed or executed outcomes

authority.enforcement: caller-supplied planning capability; not actual Tool Guard enforcement

capabilities.topology: single origin compute, single ground compute, optional relay nodes
capabilities.lifecycle_economics: separate explicitly linked sensitivity; not mission total

assumptions: Positive cash flows are expenditures; residual entries are nonpositive credits. No revenue or financing cash flows.
Cash flows are discounted at their declared year offset; useful capacity accrues over active interval intersections and is discounted at each year-end.
Both numerator and denominator use the same annual discount factor and time origin; partial-year output is credited at the containing year-end.
No output before commissioning or after retirement. Replacements require their own cohorts and cash flows.
Utilization and availability are declared synthetic constants, not inferred survival probabilities.
Discount rate is a supplied cost-of-capital assumption; interest, debt proceeds, repayments and principal are excluded to avoid financing double-counting.
Allocated/prepaid downlink expense and incremental marginal downlink expense are separate categories; callers must not enter the same invoice twice.
Single declared currency only; no FX lookup/conversion, inflation model, tax model or investment suitability conclusion.
Alternatives are sensitivity scenarios, not forecasts, accepted improvements or automatic calibration.

lifecycle.classification: synthetic sensitivity/screening; not investment advice or physical verification

static_agent_tools.authority: planning_only; no execution permission, authentication or Tool Guard authorization
static_agent_tools.promotion: never; recommendations require independent review and designated acceptance

limitations: Lifecycle USD/kW-year sensitivity is not the mission partial operating USD or a mission total.
Static agentic evaluator remains available separately; it does not gate this coupled mission evaluator.
